plugins.name: Welcome Message
plugins.author: RSPS team
plugins.description: Greets players with a welcome message in chat when they log in.

plugins.name: Custom Pets
plugins.author: Qunai
plugins.description: Turns any NPC into a pet from custom-pets.json: a follower summoned from a custom item, with Talk-to lines, an optional chathead and reclaiming from Probita.

plugins.name: GlobalBroadcasts
plugins.author: noel_
plugins.description: World chat announcements for level 99, new Collection Log slots, pets, valuable drops and first joins.

plugins.name: Skilling Contracts
plugins.author: Luka
plugins.description: Adds daily, weekly, and monthly skilling contracts, with contract pass XP and satchel rewards. Player-local resets require Luka's TSPS fork client.

plugins.name: World Map Walk
plugins.author: Luka
plugins.description: Routes players to a selected tile, including through doors and gates. The world map's Move here option requires Luka's TSPS fork client or the client source patch in the plugin directory.

plugins.name: Auto-Skill
plugins.author: Luka
plugins.description: Automates supported skilling, combat, and bank trips on your TSPS server. Fork-specific activities and desktop notifications require matching TSPS integrations.

plugins.name: Admin panel
plugins.author: GhostScape
plugins.description: In-game player editing, teleports, cheats, spawning and bot controls. Requires the matching TSPS native-interface and admin provider support.
